vue.description: Vue 3 Magnetic Button outer adapter wrapping @exhuma/core headless primitive.
vue.code:
<script setup lang="ts">
import { MagneticButton as MagneticButtonPrimitive } from '@exhuma/core';
import { clsx } from 'clsx';

interface Props {
  class?: string;
  [key: string]: unknown;
}

const props = withDefaults(defineProps<Props>(), {
  class: '',
});
</script>

<template>
  <MagneticButtonPrimitive
    v-bind="props"
    :class="clsx('relative inline-flex items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-primary px-6 py-3 font-semibold text-primary-foreground shadow-md transition-shadow hover:shadow-lg cursor-pointer will-change-transform', props.class)"
  >
    <slot />
  </MagneticButtonPrimitive>
</template>

svelte.description: Svelte 5 Magnetic Button adapter using runes and @exhuma/core primitives.
svelte.code:
<script lang="ts">
  import { MagneticButton as MagneticButtonPrimitive } from '@exhuma/core';
  import { clsx } from 'clsx';

  let {
    class: className = '',
    children,
    ...restProps
  }: {
    class?: string;
    children?: import('svelte').Snippet;
    [key: string]: unknown;
  } = $props();
</script>

<MagneticButtonPrimitive
  class={clsx('relative inline-flex items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-primary px-6 py-3 font-semibold text-primary-foreground shadow-md transition-shadow hover:shadow-lg cursor-pointer will-change-transform', className)}
  {...restProps}
>
  {@render children?.()}
</MagneticButtonPrimitive>
